tess_pm: Quick thread: sketching a migration gating + pricing options doc. Goal: balance customer assurance with catalog agility. Thoughts?

mike_eng: High level ok. Need explicit feature flags for shadow+swap and a hard rollback API.

tess_pm: Proposal outline: shadow validation -> canary -> staged swap. Pin policy: default 6 weeks grace; paid 90/180-day extended pin. Migration credit tiers for SLA hits.\nnina_eval: Bench gate must include customer-slice sampling, semantic agreement (cos_sim >=0.90 on slice), and token delta caps. Include adversarial halluc probe.

omar_ops: Ops checklist: reserve +20% pool headroom for canary windows, hot-rollback <5m, and telemetry to show per-tenant diff rates.

rita_sales: Sales input: enterprises asking for 120-day guaranteed pins. Offer 120-day as bespoke contract (higher fee) + guaranteed rollback window. Migration credit idea resonates.

legal-bot: Data retention note: shadow logs containing user prompts must be PII-scrubbed by default. Opt-in for raw logs requires DPA addendum.

mike_eng: Routing flags: shadow_mode={off,collect,compare}, swap_tier={nonpinned,softpin,hardpin}. Hot-swap API: POST /swap {tenant, target_variant} with token to authorize.

nina_eval: Bench sample_size: 500 per-customer slice min. Pass rule: cos_sim >=0.90 AND hallucination_delta <= 0.02 OR manual review.

omar_ops: Playbook steps for failed canary: 1) auto-fallback, 2) open incident with runbook, 3) notify customers in opt-in window.

tess_pm: Pricing matrix draft: default free 6-week pin; paid 90-day + migration-assist (1 SE wk) ; enterprise 120/180-day bespoke + SLA credits. Credits slip scale: 0.5% monthly credit per SLA breach up to cap.

rita_sales: I'll draft comms and sample contract clauses for pricing tiers.

mike_eng: We'll add feature flag rollout for toggling extended-pin per-tenant. Need migration-assist telemetry for billing.

legal-bot: Contract language to include: log handling, rollback obligations, liability cap for model-output regressions.

nina_eval: Also include a pre-swap smoke test: run 200 production prompts, compare top-k outputs and flag >10% divergence.

omar_ops: I'll spec the Dedicated reserve flag and playbook drafts.

tess_pm: Great. I'll assemble a PR with bench config, canary plan, pricing matrix, runbooks, and contract snippets. Tagging everyone once ready. :memo:
